# Case <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Case value
Case value1, value2, ...
```

## Description

A part of [Select](Select): the statements after it run when the selected expression equals one of the listed values. Several values are separated with commas.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
s$ = "b"
Select s$
	Case "a"
		Print "A"
	Case "b", "c"
		Print "B or C"
End Select
```

```text
B or C
```
